 Untold is more than a journaling app. We’re a world where you’re the main character, and we’re dedicated to telling your story as it unfolds. Let’s begin. Key Features AN ENCRYPTED SPACE ALL TO YOURSELF Your privacy is our #1 priority. Everything you share is fully encrypted, meaning nobody but you can access your data. LOG ENTRIES LIKE YOU’D TALK TO A FRIEND Embrace your stream of consciousness. With seamless speech-to-text AI, you can now journal as fast as you think. A NEW TYPE OF NEWSFEED THAT’S ALL ABOUT YOU Doom scrolling ends here. Shift your focus inwards with binge-able content written about you—from short stories to personality breakdowns. PROMPTS YOU ACTUALLY WANT TO ANSWER No more cookie-cutter prompts. Dive deeper with follow-up questions based on your entries. A HUMAN-FIRST APPROACH TO AI Tune out of social media and into you. With its infinite patience and quiet objectivity, we believe AI has the power to improve emotional wellbeing in unprecedented ways. 5-STAR REVIEWS “Feels like you’re talking to a person.” “Helped me process big transitions I’ve experienced lately.” “Genuinely shocked at how amazing it is.” “I feel like my brain is unclogged now.” “It’s blown my mind several times.” Privacy Policy https://untoldapp.com/privacy-policy Terms of Use https://untoldapp.com/terms

- ### Pleasantly surprised

Jan 8

 Plant_L0v3r_17 

I never write reviews for apps but oh my goodness; this app deserves the time it takes to write one. I downloaded it recently with a low bar of expectations. I figured “hey, just because it doesn’t say there’s any paid things doesn’t mean they won’t find a loop hole to try to take me money” but nope. This app is free, and i mean free free. Now let’s talk about how it functions. It’s easy to work, I can just press the voice recording button and talk. When i’m done talking it literally transcribes my words (imperfectly sometimes but most of the time it’s perfect) and then it even separates them out into paragraphs based on when i changed subjects or started down another thought. It’s absolutely incredible because i struggle to write down my thoughts in journals and even text but this app allows me to verbally process my day. Then the cherry on top is that it comes up with questions designed to deepen your thoughts, and you can just add to your entry with more voice journaling. It saves the audio too so you can listen to it whenever you want. It even highlights names you say as important and it creates fun titles for your entry (which you can edit ofc). Gosh, this app is a lifesaver for me. Thank you to whoever created it and allowed it to be free. God bless you.

Close

- ### The absolute best mental health app

10/01/2025

 Sally5150 

This app is life changing. I have struggled with PTSD, severe anxiety and BPD most of my life. I am highly self aware making most therapy very unhelpful. I got really attached to a therapist and she left. As a way to self regulate I got this thinking it was simply a voice journal, I was greatly surprised when i found out it gives specific responses to what i write. This has a response to help challenge negative thoughts and see the problem or insecurity objectively. This helps so much with rewiring generational trauma and my tendency for black and white thinking. There is a nurturing response and a psychological perspective response as well. On top of this it also categorizes your entries and labels them with emotion, allows you to make names connect with relationships, it cites previous entries to encourage you and show progress, it shows word blobs for your people you talk about, it shows % of entries in past, present and future, it gives monthly overviews and sooooo much more. I have constantly struggled to find ways to heal myself at home and with tools and resources. I’ve been in therapy for 6 years and this has helped more than anything i’ve done. I voice my entries, it writes it for me, I listen to each response and take notes. I practice the format that the response that challenges bad thoughts and its helped me slowly change those thinking patterns. I cannot say enough about this app. I was using chat gpt for a while which I know is very bad for many reasons but I wanted something to work in a similar way to help me reflect and this does just that is a much more self explorative, productive and safe way. AND ITS FREE. I am a broke college student and that really makes a difference for accessibility of an app. Thank you to the creators of this app, you’ve truly given me a tool to change my life.

Close
